description: This file defines the BatchApiService interface in the org.apache.fineract.batch.service package, declaring methods for handling batch requests with and without enclosing transactions in the Fineract project.

classes.name: BatchApiService
classes.description: A service interface that declares methods to process batch requests, either with or without enclosing transactions.

methods.name: handleBatchRequestsWithoutEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Processes a list of batch requests without wrapping them in an enclosing transaction and returns their responses.

methods.name: handleBatchRequestsWithEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Processes a list of batch requests with an enclosing transaction; if any request fails, the entire batch is rolled back.
